# `ext::tls_stream` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/tls_stream.lani#L3)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Buffered client/server TLS streams use OpenSSL 3 on Linux x86_64. connect_with_context_until borrows a prepared client Context, derives queue/read caps from it and retains a native reference through a successful Session. The ordinary connector owns its optional client Context; accepted server construction consumes its socket on every result and retains a native reference. One absolute deadline and explicit byte/call budgets cover connection and handshake. Linked guides define stable retries, manual cleanup and mutual-TLS policy. Historical stream/prepared-context receipts predate the independent OpenSSL retry revision; current selected native retry guards and migrated HTTPS application receipts have separate scopes. Excluded full buffered/prepared-context groups retain their historical receipt scope; the current selected gate did not rerun them. TLS and sensitive operations stay in OpenSSL.
